new_claims.statement: In the exact-rank-three account02/B11 null-sum finite-shared-spike chamber, after the low-leverage and scalar-pivot exits fail, if the residual sheared left coefficient frame has rank one then ||p_Q||_infinity <= 2048/s for arbitrary independent cap-one input densities. Essential boundedness only; continuity not proved in this branch.

For residual Gram G_R and at most three spike rows E, rho = det G_R + sum_{e in E,r in R} det(v_e,v_r)^2 + sum_{e<e'} det(v_e,v_e')^2. Hence det G_R<=rho/2 forces one of at most six grouped finite-spike wedge contributions to be at least rho/12.

partner.actual_inequality: At I=S, C=1 and det G_S=rho>=2^-10, the partner theorem gives a continuous C0 density with ||p_Q||inf<=96/s under the full-left leverage<=1/2 gate.

rank_two_control: For centered unit uniforms, p_{2XY}(t)=log(1/(2|t|)); the third residual square removes this via half-Riesz smoothing rather than by bounding the saddle density itself.
continuity: Partner low-leverage branch continuous C0; new rank-one residual branch essential boundedness only; global continuity open.
